陆多福入门的第二日，碧秀峰。
南宫月将两个鸡蛋夹到陆多福碗中，说道：“小福子，多吃点。今日你就要跟师姐一起修炼了，可要吃饱些，午饭我们可没时间吃。”
修炼之人忌讳中途打盹，有些高明的修士直接辟谷，可以闭关数载水米不进。南宫月自然还没到那种地步，但是为了修炼时能够心无旁骛，连午饭也省了，但又怕饿着陆多福，所以趁着早饭把他喂饱些。
“对对，多福。你师姐现在是不吃午饭的，但你可能还不习惯，要多吃点。饿着肚子可没法集中精神修炼。”南宫修也关照道。
“去去去，说的什么话。月儿不懂事，你也不懂是吧？月儿是习惯了那还好，可是多福一个十五的小伙子，正是长身体的时候，怎么能不让他吃午饭。你忘了你在这个年纪的时候，一天要吃八大碗饭了。”白云溪埋汰起了丈夫，随后将几个饭团，肉干，水果等装进一个食盒，放在陆多福面前，叮嘱道：“待会上山的时候，千万记得带着去。饿了就吃，身体才是最重要的。对了，还有水……”
“隆隆隆”，桌椅突然晃动了起来，陆多福还以为是师姐不小心动了桌子。直到椅子也在晃，最后感觉大地也在震颤，屋外有瓦片掉落在地摔得粉碎，才发现不对。
“地震了，快跑出去。”南宫修第一个反应过来，招呼三人往外面就跑。南宫修一边跑一边运足灵力一遍又一遍吼道：“地震了，所有弟子和长老速到演武场躲避。”
陆多福他们到演武场的时候，演武场上已经有了不少人。数十息时间，云隐门二百三十人全数到齐。南宫修和众长老反复确认没漏人后，松了口气。
“所有人在此避难，不得擅自离开。我去去就回来。”南宫修说完，身形快速窜出，马上消失不见。武王境高手，来去如风，在地震中自然也能穿梭自如。弟子们均在练武场有序静坐，众师长和一些年长的弟子在一边小心看护。
地震没持续多长时间，就完全平息了下来。众人虽在山上，但也明显感觉得出来此次地震破坏性极强。首先是山上的房舍坍塌了不少，尤其是弟子们所住的宿舍。不过根据负责统计的弟子回报，云隐门主要的建筑几乎没有受损。各峰的主殿，藏经阁，南宫修所在的小院等建筑主体都完好无损，只是掉了一些瓦片。
白云溪和众位长老当机立断，安排弟子们抢修。南宫月和陆多福也没闲着，加入到抢修大军中，云隐门上下忙得热火朝天。
一个时辰后，南宫修安然返回。还不等众人开口，南宫修面色沉重地道：“每一峰留下五名弟子，由四长老负责调遣，继续修缮受损的房屋。云溪，你带五十名弟子搭建帐篷，越多越好。其余弟子，跟我下山救助灾民。”南宫修声音中带了几分严厉，透露着不容反驳的威严，众人均答应下来。
“月儿，多福，你们在这帮忙搭帐篷，别乱走。”南宫修临走前叮嘱道。
南宫月问道：“爹爹，为什么要搭帐篷？我们房子不是还够住的吗？”
南宫修沉声道：“月儿你没经历过地震，不知道也不奇怪。此次地震剧烈，震源为云隐山五里外的迷雾山谷。为父刚刚看过了，山脚下的百姓，他们的房子不牢靠，塌了不少。地震之后，晚些可能会下大雨，到时候白水河水位暴涨，他们在山下不安全。我云隐门受他们恩惠颇多，岂能坐视不理，这些帐篷，正是搭建给他们住的。”
南宫月恍然大悟，陆多福也点点头，保证完成任务。南宫修拍拍两人的头，领着弟子们下山去了。
人多力量大，两个多时辰，演武场及周边，几百个帐篷已搭建好，密密麻麻排列着像一个个大馒头。陆多福之前并不会搭帐篷，借此机会边学边做，没多会就变成了小能手。
天快黑的时候，南宫修领着众弟子，带着山脚下的百姓上了山。经过一下午的抢救，三千多百姓，连同牲口，金银细软，粮食药品全部搬到山上。
百姓们上山后，最忙的就是陆多福。这次灾害造成百姓们伤亡不少，陆多福作为云隐门小神医，自然是当仁不让地负担起救治伤员的责任。

挨个上药、缝合伤口、包扎……在昏暗的油灯下，陆多福一直忙活到深夜子时，中间连口水都没喝，最后眼睛都睁不开了。
打下手的白云溪劝道：“多福，休息会吧！看你针线都拿不稳了。”
“师娘，我还坚持得住。”陆多福摇摇头，伤员实在太多了，从晌午忙活到现在，还有一半没有得到救治。
“小神医，去睡会吧。剩下的都是轻伤，交给我和老张就可以了。”说话的是云隐镇上的郎中老李头，老张则是隔壁镇上的郎中。他们二人和陆多福组成医师小队负责救治伤员，两人对陆多福的医术，那是相当佩服的。
陆多福：“这……”
白云溪道：“去吧。磨刀不误砍柴功，你去歇息，明早来接李伯伯和张伯伯的班。”
陆多福也没再坚持，他现在双眼昏花，再给人缝伤口确实不合适了，万一不小心扎错地方咋办。
除了搭建的帐篷，云隐门全部房屋都住满了人。弟子们原本是一人一床，此时也拼拼凑凑，两个人一张床，把腾出来的让出来给百姓。陆多福的房间也让出来了，在厨房里打了个地铺。
果然不出南宫修所料，天黑以后，就开始下起了雨，而且雨越下越大，最后倾盆而下。雨点打在帐篷瓦片上劈啪作响，然而云隐山在这灾难来临时却陷入难得的宁静。
现在的云隐山虽然显得拥挤，但对于避难的百姓来说，却是一个值得托付的避风港。家虽然没了，但粮食和财物保住了，等灾难过去，明日依旧充满希望。
淋漓的大雨亦无法阻止陆多福的睡意，他忙活了一天，累得不行，这一停下来，眼皮就打颤，连脚都没洗就和衣睡了。迷迷糊糊中，听见巡夜的南宫修洪亮的声音：“都打起精神来，清查屋子和帐篷，不要漏水了，别淋了乡亲们的粮食。等这趟灾难过了，再帮他们把房子修起来……”

On the second day of Lu Duofu's entry, Bi Xiufeng.
Nangong Yue put two eggs into Lu Duofu's bowl and said, "Xiao Fuzi, eat more. Today you are going to practice with senior sister, so you need to eat enough. We don't have time for lunch."
Cultivators are taboo about taking naps in the middle of the journey. Some clever monks directly engage in fasting and can stay in seclusion for several years without water or rice. Naturally, Nangong Yue hadn't reached that point yet, but in order to be able to concentrate on her practice, she even skipped lunch, but she was afraid of starving Lu Duofu, so she took advantage of breakfast to feed him.
"That's right, good luck. Your senior sister doesn't have lunch now, but you may not be used to it yet, so you need to eat more. You can't concentrate on practicing when you are hungry." Nangong Xiuye ​​said with concern.
"Go, go, go, what are you talking about? Yue'er is not sensible, and you don't understand either, right? Yue'er is used to it, so that's okay, but Duofu is a fifteen-year-old boy who is just growing up. How can he not let him have lunch? You forgot that when you were this age, you had to eat eight bowls a day It's time to eat." Bai Yunxi picked up her husband, then put a few rice balls, dried meat, fruits, etc. into a food box, placed them in front of Lu Duofu, and warned: "When you go up the mountain, remember to eat when you are hungry. By the way, there is also water..."
"Rumble", the table and chairs suddenly shook. Lu Duofu thought that the senior sister had accidentally moved the table. It wasn't until the chair was shaking, and finally I felt the ground shaking, and tiles falling to the ground and smashing to pieces outside the house, that I realized something was wrong.
"There's an earthquake, run out." Nangong Xiu was the first to react and told the three of them to run outside. As he ran, Nangong Xiu used all his spiritual power and shouted over and over again: "There's an earthquake. All disciples and elders must go to the martial arts field to take shelter."
When Lu Duofu and the others arrived at the martial arts arena, there were already many people there. In a few dozen breaths, all 230 people from the Yunyin Sect arrived. Nangong Xiu and the elders breathed a sigh of relief after repeatedly confirming that no one was missed.
"Everyone is taking refuge here and are not allowed to leave without permission. I will come back as soon as I go." After Nangong Xiu finished speaking, he quickly jumped out and disappeared immediately. A master of the Martial King Realm can come and go like the wind, and can naturally travel freely through earthquakes. The disciples all sat quietly in an orderly manner in the martial arts training ground, with the teachers and some older disciples carefully watching over them.
The earthquake didn't last long before it completely subsided. Although everyone was on the mountain, they could clearly feel that the earthquake was extremely destructive. First of all, many buildings on the mountain collapsed, especially the dormitories where the disciples lived. However, according to the report of the disciple responsible for statistics, the main buildings of Yunyinmen were almost undamaged. The main buildings of each peak, such as the main hall, the Sutra Pavilion, and the small courtyard where Nangong Xiu is located, are all intact, but some tiles have fallen off.
Bai Yunxi and the elders made a prompt decision and arranged for the disciples to make emergency repairs. Nangong Yue and Lu Duofu were not idle either, and joined the emergency repair army. Yunyinmen was very busy.
An hour later, Nangong Xiu returned safely. Before everyone could speak, Nangong Xiu said with a serious face: "Five disciples are left on each peak, and the fourth elder is responsible for dispatching them to continue repairing the damaged houses. Yunxi, you take fifty disciples to set up tents, the more the better. The rest of the disciples, follow me down the mountain to rescue the victims." Nangong Xiu's voice was a bit stern, revealing a majesty that could not be refuted, and everyone agreed.
"Yue'er, what a blessing. Please help set up the tent here and don't wander around." Nangong Xiu warned before leaving.
Nangong Yue asked: "Dad, why do you need to set up a tent? Isn't our house enough to live in?"
Nangong Xiu said solemnly: "Yue'er, you have never experienced an earthquake, so it's not surprising that you don't know. This earthquake was violent, and its source was the misty valley five miles away from Yunyin Mountain. My father just saw it and found that the houses of the people at the foot of the mountain were not stable and many collapsed. After the earthquake, there may be heavy rain later, and then the Baishui River will floodBits skyrocketed and they were not safe down the mountain. We, Yunyin Sect, have received a lot of favors from them, how can we just sit back and ignore them? These tents were built for them to live in. "
Nangong Yue suddenly realized, and Lu Duofu nodded, promising to complete the task. Nangong Xiu patted the two of them on the head and led the disciples down the mountain.
With more people comes greater strength. For more than two hours, hundreds of tents have been set up in and around the martial arts arena, densely packed like giant steamed buns. Lu Duofu didn't know how to set up a tent before, so he took this opportunity to learn and do it at the same time, and soon became a little expert.
When it was getting dark, Nangong Xiu led his disciples and took the people at the foot of the mountain up the mountain. After an afternoon of rescue work, more than 3,000 people, including their livestock, gold, silver, food and medicine, were all moved to the mountain.
After the people went up the mountain, Lu Duofu was the busiest. This disaster caused many casualties among the people. As the little miracle doctor of Yunyin Sect, Lu Duofu naturally shouldered the responsibility of treating the wounded.
Applying medicine, suturing wounds, and bandaging one by one... Under the dim oil lamp, Lu Duofu was busy until late at night. He didn't even drink any water in the middle of the night, and in the end he couldn't open his eyes.
Bai Yunxi, who was doing the job, advised: "Thank you, let's take a rest! I see you can't hold your needle and thread steady. "
"Master Wife, I can still hold on. "Lu Duofu shook his head. There were too many injured. From the busy work at noon to now, half of them have not received treatment.
"Little miracle doctor, go get some sleep. The rest are minor injuries and can be left to me and Lao Zhang. "The speaker was Lao Li Tou, a doctor from Yunyin Town, and Lao Zhang was a doctor from the next town. The two of them and Lu Duofu formed a team of doctors to treat the wounded. The two of them admired Lu Duofu's medical skills.
Lu Duofu: "This..."
Baiyun Xi said: "Go. Sharpen the knife and cut firewood without missing a beat. Go and have a rest. Come and pick up Uncle Li and Uncle Zhang tomorrow morning. "
Lu Duofu didn't insist anymore. His eyes were dim now, and it was really inappropriate to sew wounds on others. What if he accidentally stabbed the wound in the wrong place.
Except for the tents set up, all the houses in Yunyinmen were full of people. The disciples originally had one bed per person, but now they pieced together two people per bed, and gave the space to the common people. Lu Duofu's room was also given up, and a floor was built in the kitchen.
As expected by Nangong Xiu, it started to rain after dark, and the rain got heavier and heavier, and finally poured down. The raindrops crackled on the tent tiles, but Yunyin Mountain fell into a rare tranquility when this disaster struck.
Although Yunyin Mountain seems crowded now, it is a safe haven worth entrusting to the people taking refuge. Although the family is gone, the food and belongings are saved. When the disaster is over, there will still be hope for tomorrow.
Even the heavy rain could not stop Lu Duofu from falling asleep. He had been working hard all day and was so tired that when he stopped, his eyelids would tremble and he would sleep with his clothes on without even washing his feet. In a daze, I heard the loud voice of Nangong Xiu, who was on patrol at night: "Cheer up and check the houses and tents to make sure there are no leaks and the food of the folks is wet. After this disaster is over, we can help them repair their houses..."
